title: IngressRule
description: A host-based routing rule mapping HTTP requests to backend services based on hostname and path prefix matching.

host.description: Fully-qualified domain name to match. Wildcard prefixes like *.example.com are supported. If unspecified, all hosts match.

http.description: HTTP-specific routing configuration for this rule.

paths.description: List of path-to-backend mappings for this rule. At least one path must be specified.
